Get CEBL Teams

Source: R/cebl.R
cebl_teams.Rd

Every franchise identity, past and present (15 team ids; a relocated franchise has a second id).

Endpoint: GET https://api.data.cebl.ca/teams/

Usage

cebl_teams()

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Every franchise identity, past and present (15 team ids; a relocated franchise has a second id). An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py cebl_teams):

col_nametypedescription
team_idintegerCEBL team id (its own key space; not a Genius id). Joins /teams/ id, the games' home_team_id / away_team_id, team_id in player rows and the team_id / vs_team_id params. A relocated or renamed franchise has a second id: the Stats Hub groups 15+56 (Saskatchewan Rattlers, Saskatoon Mamba), 17+53 (Calgary Surge, Guelph Nighthawks), 19+55 (Brampton, Hamilton Honey Badgers) and 16+54 (Vancouver, Fraser Valley Bandits).
name_encharacterTeam full name in English ('Niagara River Lions').
short_name_encharacterTeam short name in English, usually the city ('Niagara').
name_frcharacterTeam full name in French ('River Lions de Niagara').
short_name_frcharacterTeam short name in French, usually the city.
is_activelogicalTrue for a team in the current league; false for a former identity (Guelph Nighthawks, Hamilton Honey Badgers, Fraser Valley Bandits, Saskatchewan Rattlers, Newfoundland Growlers).
logo_urlcharacterTeam logo URL (icon with the team name; upstream: 'Should include the icon and team name').
icon_urlcharacterTeam icon URL (upstream: 'Should not include the team name').

Details

  • CEBL own API, owner-approved gray area: these wrappers read the league's own FastAPI service (api.data.cebl.ca, the backend of the CEBL Stats Hub) with the X-Api-Key that the hub's own page bundle ships to every browser. The key is not issued to third parties and no developer terms were found; cebl.ca's terms of use were not reviewed. The runtime reads the key from the bundle at run time, falls back to a documented constant, never prints it, and raises hoopR_asset_fetch with a 'key rotated?' hint on a persistent 401. www.cebl.ca/robots.txt disallows nothing. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets; requests are spaced at least 1 s apart.

  • Season is the calendar year (May to August) = the sdv END year: no mapping. The first season is 2019. An unknown season, team or player answers an empty list, which the runtime raises as hoopR_no_data. Ids are CEBL's own; a relocated franchise has two team ids (cebl_teams lists all 15).

  • This API has no box-score, play-by-play or shot route. They live in Genius LiveStats (organisation CEBL, see the genius family): cebl_games and cebl_player_gamelog carry the Genius match id as genius_match_id, parsed from the stats URLs (derived, not fetched; the match of a cancelled game may have no data). home_team_id is Genius team 1 and away_team_id team 2 (checked on match 2600563).

  • Some completed schedule rows have null scores (2026), and a cancelled game has status CANELLED (the API's spelling) with null or zero scores. The schedule lists unplayed games too, so no wrapper refuses an unfinished game. Aggregates are decimal strings upstream and double here. Players' names, nationality and birth date are the public bio; no contact data is served.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty list, an all-null profile: an unknown season, team or player), hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a key the API still refuses after one re-read, any other non-200, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, a body for another season, team or player), all inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 500 is the API's answer to a bad id and is not retried. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame.

  • Deliberate divergence: a string column that the API sends as an object, or a list of objects, carries compact JSON here ({"name":"TSN"}), where sdv-py's String cast writes Python's str(dict) repr ({'name': 'TSN'}). No string column of the committed fixtures carries an object.

See also

Other CEBL Functions: cebl_games(), cebl_news(), cebl_player(), cebl_player_gamelog(), cebl_player_leaders(), cebl_player_seasons(), cebl_player_stats(), cebl_roster(), cebl_seasons(), cebl_standings(), cebl_team_stats()
